description: Reads the current revision, thin schematic, supported settings, physical context, layout freshness and latest layout job from one saved-state snapshot. layout.upgradeAvailable marks a saved EGT-1 route that the user can regenerate with EGT-2 Vela at this revision without editing the board. Reading never saves or moves a board: a private board has ownerUserId null and a private link as url, while a board in an account has an owner and a /boards/ url; use save_board_to_account to keep a private board in the connected account. Use the same boardRef before editing, checking or exporting. A completed older job does not imply a current layout. validation is the saved outcome of check_board_layout for the current layout; null means that layout has not been checked, not that it passed. Use get_generation with boardRef for status, never generate_layout as a status probe. includePreview optionally adds a saved-layout image; previewing does not change the board design or revision. Normal compute capacity limits apply.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

includePreview.description: Include an image of the current saved layout; omitted or false skips rendering. Returns preview: null when no current layout is available.

name: get_board

requestedRoutingEngine.description: Release selected for the layout requested by this save.

routingEngine.description: Recorded ID of the release that routed this saved layout.

upgradeAvailable.description: True for a saved EGT-1 layout eligible for a requested EGT-2 reroute without a board edit. Read get_board for current eligibility. A replayed save receipt describes the original save or may omit the flag.

placementIssueCount.description: Total silkscreen placement warnings when the result lists only the first warnings.

placementIssues.description: Nonblocking placement warnings for authored silkscreen on this revision. Report warnings to the user and edit placements only when asked.

restorableRevisions.description: Earlier revisions update_board can return this board to with restoreRevision, newest first: the board as it was before each of its most recent edits. Empty when there is nothing to undo.

validation.description: Saved outcome of check_board_layout for the current layout. null: that layout has not been checked, or there is none; null is not a pass.

title: Read board
